body: A rigorous drive toward purity of purpose, structure, and inner clarity; the raw instinct gets disciplined and made serious. When the rigor turns inward it can bring heavy, low stretches, so the work is keeping enough clarity that it serves you.
business: Exacting, disciplined depth; gives lasting form to the uncompromising drive.
shadow: Harshness and austerity, and weighed-down spells when the discipline turns against the self.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
